meta.description: Find jobs, review each one and send applications in batches, only for the ones you approved.

home.title: Apply to <destaque>many jobs at once</destaque>, without losing control
home.lead: You find the jobs, review each one and approve it. W2Talent sends a batch with only the ones you approved, plus a profile summary a recruiter understands in seconds.
home.step1Text: Type it the way you'd say it: “remote DevOps contractor 15k”. The AI shows what it understood and you adjust.
home.step2Text: Each job shows how well it matches your profile and what's missing, before you decide.
home.step3Text: Only what you approved goes out. If the job changes later, the approval is dropped.
home.step4Text: Up to 10 per batch and 30 per day. Jobs already sent are marked and never sent again.
home.recruitersText: Candidates arrive with the W2 Profile: a standard summary with the required fields filled in and the match explained. Post a job by pasting its text; the AI organizes the fields and warns you if it already exists.
home.faq1q: Do I have to pay to apply?
home.faq1a: No. Candidates use it for free.
home.faq2q: Are my phone and email exposed?
home.faq2a: No. Your contact stays protected until you reply to a company or get invited to an interview; then only that job's company sees your e-mail and phone, and you get a notice.
home.faq3a: Yes. The same account works on computer and phone, and you can install it as an app.
home.faq4a: Not yet. This is the test version, and it changes often.

ia.metaDescription: Where artificial intelligence shows up in W2Talent, what data it uses and why a person always makes the decision.
ia.title: How we use AI
ia.lead: AI helps read résumés, summarize profiles and sort results. A person always decides: you approve every application and the recruiter chooses who to talk to.
ia.p1: Nothing is sent without your approval. You approve each job before it goes out.
ia.p2: AI never rules anyone out. It only sorts what already matches the search.
ia.p3: Text written by AI is labeled and can be edited before it goes out.
ia.p4: AI is told not to use or infer age, gender, photo, marital status, origin or health.
ia.p5: Email and phone never go to AI providers outside Cloudflare.
ia.cvFaz: Fills in your profile fields from your résumé.
ia.cvDados: The résumé text, without email or phone (those are read by rules, outside the AI).
ia.cvDecide: You check and fix every field.
ia.w2Faz: Writes a summary of up to 3 sentences and up to 3 highlights.
ia.w2Dados: Your profile fields, without name or contact details.
ia.vagaFaz: Fills in the job fields from the pasted text, warns about a similar job the company already posted and suggests a salary range from the median of 5 or more similar jobs.
ia.vagaDados: The job text, without email or phone.
ia.vagaDecide: The recruiter checks every field and decides whether to post.
ia.viesFaz: Fixed rules flag words in the job text that exclude people by age, gender, appearance, origin, family, health or religion, and suggest a replacement. If the recruiter asks, AI proposes a rewrite without those words. The same rules check the role, goal, summary and highlights of the W2 Profile and warn the candidate when the text reveals one of these details; there is no AI rewrite on the W2 Profile.
ia.viesDados: The job title, description and benefits, without email or phone; on the W2 Profile, the role, goal, summary and highlights. The rules run in the browser; AI only gets the job text when the recruiter asks, and the W2 Profile text is not sent to AI by this reviewer.
ia.viesDecide: Whoever writes the text. The warning does not block publishing a job or saving or publishing the W2 Profile, and the AI proposal is only used if the recruiter chooses it.
ia.perguntasFaz: Suggests 6 to 8 questions, the same for every candidate, based on the job's skills and responsibilities, and what to look for in the answer.
ia.perguntasDados: The job title, level, skills and responsibilities. Nothing about candidates.
ia.perguntasDecide: The recruiter decides whether to use them. Questions are not stored and score no one.
ia.buscaFaz: Finds jobs and profiles that use different words for the same thing.
ia.buscaDados: The search text and the text of jobs and profiles, without contact details.
ia.buscaDecide: It only reorders what already matches the text.
ia.parecidasFaz: Shows up to 5 jobs close to the one you are viewing.
ia.parecidasDados: Only the text of the jobs.
ia.parecidasDecide: You choose whether to open them.
ia.matchFaz: Not AI: a calculation with fixed weights (skills 40, level 20, contract, work model and range 20, job date 10, complete profile 10). A skill close to the one asked for (e.g. OpenShift for Kubernetes) counts half; the list of close skills is fixed and written by hand.
ia.matchDados: Your search or your profile and the job fields. On the Candidates screen, the recruiter picks a job from their company and the same calculation measures the profile against it. On the dashboard, the same calculation shows the candidate what their profile most lacks for the closest open jobs, without the salary range.
ia.matchDecide: Used for sorting; nobody is cut by the number.
ia.fornecedores1: By default, AI runs on Cloudflare (Workers AI), where W2Talent already runs. The administrator can turn on another provider for a task; in that case, email and phone are removed from the text before it leaves.
ia.fornecedores2: We do not keep the text sent to the AI. We only keep the date, task, model, time and cost of each call.
ia.revisao1: If an AI suggestion harmed you, or you want a person to review what was done, write to <email></email>. Brazil's LGPD (art. 20) guarantees this request for automated decisions; here no decision is fully automated, but the request still applies.
ia.ajudaFaz: Finds the help article passages closest to the question and writes a short answer using only them, with the article link. If the articles do not answer it, it says so and offers to talk to a person on the team.
ia.ajudaDados: The question, without email or phone, and the help articles. Nothing from your account. Unanswered questions are kept for 90 days, without IP or account, so we can improve the articles.
ia.ajudaDecide: You check the linked article. What AI does not know, a person on the team answers in the conversation, with no AI.
ia.traducaoFaz: Translates job titles, descriptions and benefits and, for recruiters, the title, summary, highlights and job titles of the W2 Profile, so each person reads them in the site language. Technology names, numbers and contacts do not change; a translation that alters them is discarded.
ia.traducaoDados: The job text and the published W2 Profile text, without email, phone or the person's name.
ia.traducaoDecide: You. The translation is labeled and the "Show original" button shows the text the company wrote. Whoever posted it still sees only the original.
ia.mercadoFaz: Not AI: a daily calculation over the site's jobs and profiles. It shows salary ranges, the most requested skills and candidates' expected pay as ranges, only with 10 or more records (and 3 or more companies, for jobs).
ia.mercadoDados: Ranges of active jobs and monthly expected pay from published profiles, without names or contacts. Sample jobs and profiles are left out.
ia.mercadoDecide: No one: these are reference numbers only. Recruiters see expected pay only as a range over 10 or more profiles, never anyone's own.
ia.rankingFaz: Changes only the order of a job's candidates, based on who the company moves to interview and who it marks as not moving forward. The match % shown is still the same calculation.
ia.rankingDados: The 5 parts of the match (skills, level, conditions, how recent, completeness). Never age, gender, photo, marital status or address. Sample data and data from rejected companies are left out.
ia.rankingDecide: It is not AI and decides nothing: each weight changes by at most 50%, and only after 30 decisions. Recruiters can see the default order, and the admin can turn it off.
ia.atendimentoFaz: Not AI: a person on the W2Talent team answers the conversation. No reply is written or suggested by AI.
ia.atendimentoDados: What you write in the conversation, the screen you came from and, when signed in, whether the account is a candidate or a recruiter. None of it goes to an AI model. The conversation is deleted 180 days after it is closed.
ia.atendimentoDecide: A person on the team reads and replies. AI takes no part.

publicar.title: Post a job
publicar.intro: Paste the job description as you already wrote it. AI fills in the fields and you check everything before posting.
publicar.gateBody: Sign in with a recruiter account to post jobs.
publicar.gateCandidate: This is a candidate account. To post jobs, sign in with a recruiter account.
publicar.mfaBody: To post jobs, turn on the authenticator. It protects the jobs and people's data.
publicar.semEmpresaBody: Jobs are posted on behalf of the company. It takes a minute.
publicar.rejeitadaBody: W2Talent couldn't verify the company. Contact contato@w2talent.com.
publicar.atualizadaBodySemPrazo: Your changes already show in search. The job keeps its previous end date.
publicar.publicadaBody: It already shows in the job search and stays active for 14 days.
publicar.publicadaBodyPendente: It already shows in the search, with the "Unverified company" label until W2Talent checks the company. It stays active for 14 days.
publicar.colarHint: Paste everything: title, requirements, salary, benefits. Emails and phone numbers are removed before reading.
publicar.lidaIa: AI filled in the fields from the text. Check each one before posting.
publicar.lidaRegras: AI didn't respond right now; we filled in what we could read. Complete the missing fields.
publicar.editando: You'll update the job "{titulo}" with this data.
publicar.duplicadaTitle: Your company already has a similar active job
publicar.duplicadaHint: If it's a different job, you can post it anyway.
publicar.skillsHint: Separate with commas. E.g.: AWS, Terraform, Python
publicar.skillsDesconhecidas: We don't recognize: {lista}. Check the spelling or remove it.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp notices
whatsapp.noProfile: To get notices on WhatsApp, first create your profile.
whatsapp.why: We let you know when a company views your application, when it changes stage, about interviews, approved jobs about to expire and replies from the team. Only the job title, the company name and a link to the website. At most 3 a day, from 8am to 8pm (Brasília time).
whatsapp.numberHint: With area code. Outside Brazil, start with + and the country code.
whatsapp.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code on WhatsApp to {numero}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
whatsapp.testMode: Test mode: WhatsApp sending is not turned on in this environment yet, so no message was sent.
whatsapp.statusOnHint: To stop, use the button below or reply STOP on WhatsApp. It turns off right away.
whatsapp.errorNumber: Invalid number. Check the area code and digits.
whatsapp.errorLandline: Use a mobile number (in Brazil, starting with 9).
whatsapp.errorLimit: You already asked for 3 codes today. Try again tomorrow.
whatsapp.errorSend: We could not send the code now. Try again in a few minutes.
whatsapp.errorExpired: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
whatsapp.errorAttempts: Too many attempts with this code. Ask for a new one.
whatsapp.errorCode: The code does not match. Check it and try again.
whatsapp.errorConsent: Tick the authorization to turn on the notices.
